name: charlottendal-tkl
description: Charlottendal TKL och en separat LocoNet-anläggningssimulator

scripts.test:integration: node --test test/integration.mjs test/password-integration.mjs test/serial-integration.mjs test/trainmeet-integration.mjs test/panel-reset-integration.mjs test/yard-integration.mjs test/tracking-integration.mjs test/live-offline-integration.mjs test/station-traffic-integration.mjs test/station-selection-integration.mjs
scripts.import:operations: python3 scripts/import-operations.py && node scripts/make-network-profile.mjs && node scripts/make-rules.mjs && node scripts/make-migration.mjs && node scripts/make-train-fields.mjs && python3 scripts/make-signal-catalog.py && node scripts/make-indications.mjs && node scripts/make-signal-endpoints.mjs
scripts.verify:operations: python3 scripts/import-operations.py --check && node scripts/make-network-profile.mjs --check && node scripts/make-rules.mjs --check && node scripts/make-migration.mjs --check && node scripts/make-train-fields.mjs --check && python3 scripts/make-signal-catalog.py --check && node scripts/make-indications.mjs --check && node scripts/make-signal-endpoints.mjs --check
scripts.import:trakvista: python3 scripts/import-source.py --source stations/trakvista/Trakvista.xml --out stations/trakvista/data/source && python3 scripts/import-layout.py stations/trakvista/Trakvista.xml --panel Träkvista --station stations/trakvista/station.json --out stations/trakvista/data/panel.json && python3 scripts/import-logixng.py stations/trakvista && node scripts/make-station-profile.mjs stations/trakvista
scripts.verify:trakvista: python3 scripts/import-source.py --source stations/trakvista/Trakvista.xml --out stations/trakvista/data/source --check >/dev/null && python3 scripts/import-layout.py stations/trakvista/Trakvista.xml --panel Träkvista --station stations/trakvista/station.json --out stations/trakvista/data/panel.json --check && python3 scripts/import-logixng.py stations/trakvista --check && node scripts/make-station-profile.mjs stations/trakvista --check
